prs.title: fix(nitro,vite): always link `dist` to static output
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

### 📚 Description

with `nitro: { static: true }`, `nuxt build` on `main` produces a real `dist` directory containing nothing but SSR sourcemaps, rather than the `dist` -> `.output/public` symlink we create on v4:

```
dist/index.mjs.map.json
dist/server.mjs.map.json
dist/_nuxt/pages-DEvIEIO8.js.map.json
...
```

basically, when nitro runs as a vite environment, the `dist` symlink is only created in the legacy build path, so it's never created at all.

1. the sourcemap preserver wrote its `.map.json` files against `dist`, but nothing read them in vite environment api anyway, so this PR skips the export half as well, and links `dist` from the `compiled` hook in the vite environment path

2. the existing check used `existsSync`, which follows symlinks, so a dangling `dist` link would never be replaced

prs.title: fix(vite-server): scope asset url helpers to the build
prs.author: tada5hi
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

resolves #36589

### 📚 Description

Server chunks read asset URLs through the process-wide `__buildAssetsURL` / `__publicAssetsURL` globals. When several vite-server handlers are imported into one process, the last one imported answers for all of them, so an app renders another app's asset URLs.

`renderBuiltUrl` emits these expressions when a chunk is rendered, which is too late for them to import anything. So this PR keeps the global but scopes it to the build:

- vite-server wraps the configured `renderBuiltUrl` for server builds and rewrites the expression to `globalThis["__nuxt_assets:<hash>"].buildAssetsURL(...)`.
- The generated handler passes the same key to `createRendererOptions`, which installs the helpers under it.

The key hashes the build directory together with the build id, because a build id may be pinned to the same value for several apps (for example, a commit hash). The unscoped globals are still set, for code that reads them directly.

The fixture test installs a foreign `__buildAssetsURL` before the page chunk loads. Without the fix, the page renders `/other-build/logo.svg`.

prs.title: fix(nitro): pass the sent response to v2 `render:response` listeners
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

### 📚 Description

previously we used to send a stale copy of `event.res` to this (legacy) hook in compat mode. they now get the status and headers of the response that is actually sent.
